case.question: Micro820 ladder rung has input X1 in series with output Y2 coil (simple logic). After a power loss, Y2 stays de-energized even though X1 is now on. What's most likely?

key_points: Micro820 retentive outputs require explicit programming (bit retention via parameters or latch/unlatch coils)
Default behavior: outputs de-energize on power loss and require re-scan to re-energize
Y2 will energize on next scan after X1 goes true, unless the logic or I/O module prevents it
wrong_if: Blames the PLC as broken when the logic simply requires manual restart
Claims Micro820 automatically retains all outputs (false—requires config)
